title: Precision Alignment
statement: The task is to maximize the minimum triple sum over n labs (n up to 2·10^5, k up to 10^18) using at most k sign-driven unit adjustments. Case analysis shows a lab not in ascending order gains +1 per action, a lab with a<=b<=c must first spend min(b-a,c-b)+1 decrements, and an all-equal lab is frozen; then binary search the answer on total cost.
